name: nova_reel_generate
description: Generate a video from a text prompt using Amazon Nova Reel. Submits an asynchronous job and returns the job ARN immediately. Use nova_reel_status to check progress. Videos are 6-120 seconds long at 24fps and 1280x720 resolution.

prompt.description: The text prompt describing the video to generate

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the video in seconds, 6-120 (optional, default = 6)
